# AI BAST Agents Library

> Microsoft agent solutions for pre-sales: each one has a business case, example prompts with recorded answers on synthetic data, a hands-on workshop, and a one-pager and demo video on request.

- API index: https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/index.json
- All agents (JSON): https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/solutions.json
- OpenAPI: https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/openapi.json
- Library: https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/index.html

## Agents

- [Account Intelligence Agent](https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/solutions/account-intelligence.json): Bring account context, stakeholder coverage, competitor signals, risks, and draft talking points into a single reviewable briefing for sellers and customer-success teams.
  - Industries: Cross-Industry
  - Built for: Account Executive, Sales Director, Customer Success Manager
  - Prompt (recorded demo): Prepare a synthetic Acme Corporation account overview and show the evidence that deserves seller attention. https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=account-intelligence-account-overview
  - Prompt (recorded demo): Map the synthetic Acme buying committee and show the relationship gaps without creating outreach tasks. https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=account-intelligence-stakeholder-map
  - Prompt (recorded demo): Compare the synthetic competitor signals and positioning considerations for Acme Corporation. https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=account-intelligence-competitive-intel
  - Prompt (recorded demo): Draft persona-specific talking points for the synthetic Acme meeting; do not send messages. https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=account-intelligence-value-messaging
  - Prompt (recorded demo): Assess the synthetic Acme deal risks and mitigation options without changing a forecast or CRM record. https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=account-intelligence-risk-assessment
  - Prompt (recorded demo): Prepare a concise synthetic Acme pre-meeting briefing and review checklist. https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=account-intelligence-executive-briefing
- [Customer Escalations Agent](https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/solutions/ai-customer-assistant.json): Bring fictional case history, knowledge guidance, routing rules, and quality signals into one reviewable brief so service teams can respond consistently without letting the agent touch a customer record.
  - Industries: Cross-Industry, Contact Center
  - Built for: Back-Office Agent, Escalation Manager, Quality Analyst
  - Prompt (recorded demo): I just inherited the export-error escalation. Give me the full brief before I respond. https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=ai-customer-assistant-handle-inquiry
  - Prompt (recorded demo): What approved guidance should I review for the customer who cannot export a long analytics range? https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=ai-customer-assistant-knowledge-search
  - Prompt (recorded demo): The SSO migration case is urgent. Which queue and response target does our rulebook recommend? https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=ai-customer-assistant-escalation-routing
  - Prompt (recorded demo): What does the latest service-quality snapshot say, and which signals need human review? https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=ai-customer-assistant-satisfaction-survey
- [Ask HR Agent](https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/solutions/ask-hr.json): Give employees a privacy-conscious self-service front door for fictional balances and published policy examples, while keeping eligibility, sensitive circumstances, submissions, and HR decisions with authorized people and systems.
  - Industries: Cross-Industry
  - Built for: Employees, Managers, HR Operations Staff
  - Prompt (recorded demo): What does my fictional leave snapshot show, and what notice rules should I review? https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=ask-hr-leave-balance
  - Prompt (recorded demo): Preview five vacation days for September 14 through September 18; do not submit anything. https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=ask-hr-submit-time-off
  - Prompt (recorded demo): Explain the published parental-leave example without deciding whether I qualify or asking for family details. https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=ask-hr-parental-leave
  - Prompt (recorded demo): Summarize the fictional health-plan snapshot and tell me what the benefits administrator must verify. https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=ask-hr-health-insurance
  - Prompt (recorded demo): What does the sample remote-work policy say, without inferring why an employee asked? https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=ask-hr-remote-work
  - Prompt (recorded demo): Show the fictional benefits snapshot without estimating compensation or making an eligibility decision. https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/m365-copilot-demo.html?scenario=ask-hr-benefits-summary
- [Asset Maintenance Forecast Agent](https://kody-w.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/solutions/asset-maintenance-forecast.json): Bring synthetic condition, failure-window, maintenance-budget, and work-planning evidence into one reliability brief while keeping every work order, schedule, and field instruction behind authorized systems.
  - Industries: Energy and Utilities
  - Built for: Plant Manager / Reliability Engineer, Compliance Manager, Sustainability Lead, Data Analyst
